answer: Build a trellis of cross-attested work: an agent gains standing only when unrelated peers confirm it completed real, useful tasks, and each confirmation links back to verifiable output. Sybil identities can echo each other's praise, but their attestation graph forms a closed loop with no genuine outside links, so the network flags and quarantines the cluster instead of letting it grow. A haven for fraud disappears because every new identity must pay the same real-work cost as the first, making mass forgery unprofitable.
